title: Downloading Group Information to a CSV File

blocks.text: To download a CSV file of groups and their information:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Users.
On the Groups tab, click Download.

blocks.text: This CSV file can't be used to import groups because it uses a different format. If you need to import a CSV file to make modifications to groups, use the same format as the Sample Import CSV file provided by the Zscaler service.
